name: semetrics-web
description: Web SDK for Semetrics — page views, traffic sources, JS errors and Web Vitals with a persistent queue and sendBeacon delivery. No cookies.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2019 --external:web-vitals --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild src/global.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2019 --minify --outfile=dist/semetrics.min.js && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly
